instructions.D_13_ai_workspace: FINAL D13 CANDIDATE-BLUEPRINT RETRY. In the four-cell reference board, the top-right ITERATION_TARGET is the approved D13 structural blueprint. Copy its full-screen geometry and information architecture exactly; do not reinterpret it and do not reuse the rejected card-heavy candidate. Preserve these five fixed bands: (1) one slim dark Product rail flush to the left viewport edge with AI 工程 as the single cinnabar selected item; (2) one ClearVision STUDIO global header to the right of the rail; (3) one local title row containing AI 工程工作台 and 独立方案; (4) one flat three-column workbench separated by straight vertical dividers, with the left candidate-readiness column, the wide center application-preview and plan/build column, and the right validation/handoff column at the same boundaries and proportions as ITERATION_TARGET; (5) one always-visible bottom session strip spanning the whole work area to the right of the rail, containing 会话版本 8 at its lower-left.
